title: Turn scores into a token
brief: Build temperature, a top-k and top-p filter, and the full sampling step that draws one token from a vector of scores.
hints: apply_temperature divides the logits by the temperature, subtracts the maximum, exponentiates, and divides by the sum. The subtraction is what keeps a temperature of 0.001 from overflowing.

For top-k, np.argsort(-probs)[:k] lists the k largest. For top-p, sort descending, take np.cumsum, and keep up to and including the index np.searchsorted(cumulative, p, side='left') returns. Clamp that index to len(probs) - 1, because rounding can leave the last total just below 1.0.

sample_token: temperature 0 means greedy, so return int(np.argmax(logits)). Otherwise apply the temperature, filter, and draw with rng.choice(len(probs), p=probs). Use the rng you are given, never np.random.
